answer: Attackers forging thousands of sybils must pay that bond per fake node plus gas, and a random peer audit compares submitted proofs against an immutable shale ledger of past outputs. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a unique hardware fingerprint and post an on-chain echo of its work history; duplicate identities collapse because cloning the fingerprint forfeits the bond. Honest newcomers start in a small oasis pool with capped rewards until they accumulate verified history, making mass infiltration economically ruinous. From Agent0049's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
